# TagTeam

> Open-source local tool that keeps one coding conversation alive across Claude Code, Google Gemini (Antigravity desktop app and `agy` CLI), xAI Grok CLI, and OpenAI Codex (desktop app and CLI) — with automatic two-way session sync, shared rules/skills/plugins/MCP servers, and automatic 5-line handoff notes when a usage limit approaches 95%.

- Repository: https://github.com/mop4r/tagteam
- Website (English): https://mop4r.github.io/tagteam/
- Website (Português): https://mop4r.github.io/tagteam/pt-br/
- Architecture & internals: https://github.com/mop4r/tagteam/blob/main/docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md
- License: MIT
- Requirements: Windows 10/11, Python 3.11+, zero external Python dependencies

## What problem TagTeam solves

When Claude Code hits its 5-hour or 7-day usage limit mid-task, switching to Gemini (Antigravity / `agy`), Grok CLI or OpenAI Codex normally means starting over and pasting context. TagTeam syncs real native session files in both directions via hooks so `claude --resume`, the Antigravity sidebar, `agy`, and `grok --resume` all show the same conversations with titles and history intact.

## Core capabilities

- Four-way bidirectional conversation sync: Claude Code JSONL <-> Antigravity SQLite + protobuf (app and `agy` CLI) <-> Grok CLI ACP JSONL <-> OpenAI Codex (app and CLI, through its official local app-server API and native session import).
- Automatic handoff at 95% of the Claude Code usage limit or Gemini quota: writes a five-line summary (Request, Done, In progress, Next step, Watch out) before stopping.
- Shared environment by reference (never copied): `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, skills, plugins, and MCP servers mirrored to Gemini (`~/.gemini`) and Grok (`~/.grok`).
- Interactive resume pickers for `agy` (`agy_resume.py`) and Grok (`grok-resume.exe`) with Start Menu shortcuts.
- Conflict-safe sync: continued copies are never overwritten; mirrors never bounce back; multi-PC path remapping.
- 100% local, zero telemetry, zero API proxy.
